metadata.name: meridian
metadata.description: Meridian: binary MAG7 0DTE outcome markets on Solana

instructions.name: add_strike
docs: Admin only; same code path as create_strike_market (strikes are add-only, D20).

accounts.name: authority
docs: `market_creator` for create_strike_market, `admin` for add_strike (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: book
docs: instruction may allocate); `grow_book` grows it to `OrderBook::LEN` and initialises it.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Yes escrow for resting asks and makers' free Yes.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: USDC escrow for resting bids and makers' free USDC.

instructions.name: buy_no_limit
docs: Buy No limit: mint `qty` pairs and offer the Yes at `yes_price`, tagged BUY_NO.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Yes escrow; checked against `book.base_vault` in the handler.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: USDC escrow; checked against `book.quote_vault` in the handler.

accounts.name: ledger
docs: The taker's ledger: created on first use (MER-21); holds resting locks.

instructions.name: buy_no_market
docs: Buy No at market: mint exactly the fillable quantity and sell that Yes into bids
at `min_yes_price` or better. Fails with NoLiquidity if nothing fills.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Yes escrow; checked against `book.base_vault` in the handler.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: USDC escrow; checked against `book.quote_vault` in the handler.

accounts.name: ledger
docs: The taker's ledger: created on first use (MER-21); holds resting locks.

instructions.name: cancel_all
docs: Cancels every resting order of the signer in this market.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Checked against `book.base_vault`.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: Checked against `book.quote_vault`.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Owner only; always allowed. A BUY_NO order merges its unfilled Yes with No.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Checked against `book.base_vault`.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: Checked against `book.quote_vault`.

instructions.name: create_strike_market
docs: market_creator only; idempotent.

accounts.name: authority
docs: `market_creator` for create_strike_market, `admin` for add_strike (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: book
docs: instruction may allocate); `grow_book` grows it to `OrderBook::LEN` and initialises it.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Yes escrow for resting asks and makers' free Yes.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: USDC escrow for resting bids and makers' free USDC.

instructions.name: create_ticker_day
docs: market_creator only; idempotent. Times are UTC unix seconds for the ET date.

instructions.name: grow_book
docs: Permissionless. Grows the market's order book by 10 KiB until it reaches full size.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates `Config` once. Signer must be the program's upgrade authority.

accounts.name: deployer
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front-run initialisation.

instructions.name: merge_pair
docs: Burn n Yes + n No; n x $1.00 USDC back. Works while paused and after the halt.

instructions.name: mint_pair
docs: n x $1.00 USDC into the vault; mint n Yes + n No.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Admin only. Stops entry (mint_pair, new orders) only (D30).

instructions.name: place_order
docs: Buy Yes (BID) or Sell Yes (ASK). `price` is the limit, or the worst price for IOC.
Makers' UserLedgers go in remaining accounts.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Yes escrow; checked against `book.base_vault` in the handler.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: USDC escrow; checked against `book.quote_vault` in the handler.

accounts.name: ledger
docs: The taker's ledger: created on first use (MER-21); holds resting locks.

instructions.name: sell_no
docs: Sell No: buy Yes up to `max_yes_price` (IOC, capped at `qty`) and merge it.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Yes escrow; checked against `book.base_vault` in the handler.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: USDC escrow; checked against `book.quote_vault` in the handler.

accounts.name: ledger
docs: The taker's ledger: created on first use (MER-21); holds resting locks.

instructions.name: sweep_fees
docs: Permissionless. Moves a market's accrued taker fees to Config.fee_vault.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Admin only.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin only. Roles, fees, thresholds, tickers (bounds-checked).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Ledger free USDC and Yes to the owner's token accounts. Always allowed.

accounts.name: ledger
docs: Seeds bind the ledger to the signer: nobody can withdraw another user's ledger (SEC-03).

types.name: BookOrder
docs: One resting order (56 bytes).

fields.name: qty
docs: Remaining (unfilled) quantity.

fields.name: tag
docs: `ORDER_TAG_*`.

types.name: ConfigUpdate
docs: Every field is optional; only the fields that are `Some` change.
`usdc_mint` is fixed at initialisation. Pause has its own instructions.

types.name: FeesSwept
docs: Accrued taker fees moved from a market's quote vault to `Config.fee_vault` (MER-25).

types.name: Level
docs: One price level: orders in time priority, oldest first (FIFO). Fills take from the
front; a cancel removes its order and closes the gap, so the order stays FIFO.

fields.name: seq
docs: Per-market monotonic event sequence (spec 4.6).

types.name: OrderBook
docs: Zero-copy order book (MER-20, spec 4.1): 99 Yes price levels per side.
`levels[side * 99 + price - 1]`, side 0 = bids, 1 = asks.
The `total_*` fields are the sums of every `UserLedger` of this market, so the book
escrow invariant (spec 4.3 #7) is checked on-chain without reading every ledger:
`base_vault >= total_locked_yes + total_free_yes` and
`quote_vault >= total_locked_usdc + total_free_usdc + fees_accrued`.

fields.name: base_vault
docs: Yes escrow (SPL token account, authority = Market PDA).

fields.name: quote_vault
docs: USDC escrow (SPL token account, authority = Market PDA).

fields.name: fees_accrued
docs: Taker fees held in the quote vault until `sweep_fees` (MER-25).

fields.name: qty
docs: Quantity removed from the book (the unfilled remainder).

fields.name: date
docs: ET calendar date, YYYYMMDD (D31).

fields.name: symbol
docs: ASCII symbol, zero-padded (e.g. "META\0\0\0\0").

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth price feed id.

types.name: UserLedger
docs: Maker proceeds and locked balances per (market, owner) (spec 4.1, R4.6). Used from Phase 2.
